# fast-deep-equal test cases

Copied unchanged from [fast-deep-equal](https://github.com/epoberezkin/fast-deep-equal)
v3.1.3 (commit `d807ffc5013e710deb1c63d463a03f729bcd144d`), `spec/tests.js` and
`spec/es6tests.js`. MIT licensed; see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

`react-fast-compare` is a fork of fast-deep-equal, so its test cases are the
bulk of ours. Upstream hasn't released since 2020; when syncing a newer
upstream version, copy these files again and update the version above.
